subject.title: macOS launchd: plugin/config maintenance can leave Control UI in broken partial-reload state; restart may require doctor --fix

question: What degraded-state contract should Gateway and Control UI expose while macOS launchd/config/plugin maintenance is mid-reload or restart-deferred?
rationale: The remaining work is not one mechanical bug fix: maintainers need to choose the product semantics for readiness, `sessions.resolve`, Control UI UX, and operator recovery before implementation.

options.title: Define shared degraded-state contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and design one cross-surface contract before changing Gateway RPC and Control UI behavior.

options.title: Limit scope to the WebChat notice path
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95154 or a replacement only for the narrower blank-chat restart notice and leave broader readiness work separate.

options.title: Document operator-only recovery
options.body: Decide that live plugin/config maintenance remains unsupported beyond doctor/restart recovery, then close after a maintainer-owned rejection comment.

recommendation.title: Define shared degraded-state contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and design one cross-surface contract before changing Gateway RPC and Control UI behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent PR carried the central gateway/session/restart surfaces that would need a coherent degraded-state contract.
